title: Benefits of Fresh Blueberries: What They Add to Your Daily Diet
metaDescription: Discover the benefits of fresh blueberries: fiber, vitamin C, vitamin K, manganese and anthocyanins in a low-calorie fruit. Complete Fresh Pick guide.
excerpt: Few fruits pack so much into so little: fiber, vitamins, minerals and natural antioxidants in a low-calorie serving. We tell you what a cup of blueberries really provides.
imageAlt: Hand holding freshly picked blueberries at the Fresh Pick farm in Guasca

blocks.text: Blueberries are one of the most valued fruits in healthy eating, and that is no coincidence: in a small, low-calorie serving they bring together fiber, vitamins, minerals and natural antioxidant compounds. In this guide we explain what they really provide and how to get the most out of them.

Every 100 g of fresh blueberries provides around 57 kcal, which makes them an ideal choice for those who want to eat well without overdoing it. They also contain approximately 84% water, so they contribute to hydration too.
A source of vitamin C, vitamin K and manganese

A 100 g serving covers about 11% of the daily value of vitamin C, around 16% of vitamin K and approximately 15% of manganese. Vitamin C takes part in the normal functioning of the immune system; vitamin K, in normal blood clotting; and manganese, in energy metabolism.
Anthocyanins: the secret of their blue color

The intense blue-purple color of blueberries comes from anthocyanins, a group of natural pigments with antioxidant activity. Scientific research on anthocyanins and health is very active and the results are promising, although the extent to which they translate into concrete benefits for people is still being studied.
The best way to make the most of blueberries is simple: eat them often, as part of a varied and balanced diet.
With about 2.4 g of fiber per 100 g, blueberries add to your daily fiber intake, which supports normal intestinal transit and provides a feeling of fullness.
How many blueberries should you eat a day?

There is no magic amount, but a cup (about 150 g) is a practical serving that you can include at breakfast, as a snack or in a smoothie. What matters is consistency and combining them with other fruits, vegetables and whole foods.

A blueberry picked at its point of ripeness, with no artificial waxes and with its natural bloom intact keeps its flavor, firmness and texture better. That is why at Fresh Pick we hand-pick in Guasca, above 2,800 m, and deliver straight to your home.
